description: The plot illustrates the relationship between model accuracy and the s_pop frequency (scaled by 10⁴) for two distinct conditions, represented by two lines with error bars. The x-axis, labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4),” spans from 1 to 19 in linear increments, with major ticks at every 2 units. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear steps of 0.2. The upper line, shown in blue with circle markers and a dashed line style, begins at approximately 0.75 at x=1, rises to near 1.0 by x=5, remains close to 1.0 through x=11, dips slightly to ~0.88 at x=13, then recovers to 1.0 by x=17 and holds steady through x=19. The lower line, shown in green with square markers and a solid line style, starts at ~0.36 at x=1, increases to ~0.68 at x=7, dips to ~0.44 at x=9, rises again to ~0.68 at x=11, drops to ~0.50 at x=13, falls further to ~0.48 at x=15, then sharply climbs to 1.0 at x=17 and remains at 1.0 through x=19. Both lines include vertical error bars indicating variability, with the green line generally exhibiting larger error margins, especially around x=9 and x=13. A gray square legend marker is present in the lower-left corner but is not labeled, suggesting it may correspond to an unannotated or placeholder condition.
